items.title: H3 Max Image to Video
items.shortDescription: fal's H3 Max is a post-trained variant of MiniMax H3, tuned for stronger prompt adherence and better aesthetics while co-optimized with our custom inference stack for higher throughput with no compromises on output quality
items.pricingInfoOverride:
Video costs **$0.0125** per second at **480p**, **$0.02** per second at **768p**.

Note: these are promotional launch rates, 75% off for a limited time. The discount ends September 7, after which 480p is $0.05/second and 768p is $0.08/second.
items.billingMessage: Note: these are promotional launch rates — 50% off for a limited time. The discount ends September 1, after which 480p is $0.05/second and 768p is $0.08/second.

items.title: MiniMax H3 Image to Video LoRA
items.shortDescription: Images into video with synchronized audio using MiniMax H3; your image becomes the first frame, prompt optional, with trained LoRA support for subject consistency.
items.pricingInfoOverride: Video costs **$0.0625** per second at **480p**, **$0.075** per second at **768p**, **$0.1625** per second at **2K** and **$0.20** per second at **4K**.

items.title: MiniMax H3 Image to Video
items.shortDescription: MiniMax H3 is a frontier video model. This endpoint animates a supplied image into 2K video, using it as the opening frame or pairs a first and last frame to control a transition between two images with the aspect ratio following the input.
items.pricingInfoOverride: Video costs **$0.05** per second at **480p**, **$0.06** per second at **768p**, **$0.13** per second at **2K** and **$0.16** per second at **4K**.
